brief:
The user likes horror and action movies, particularly guns, action, and excitement. They did not explain what specifically appeals to them about horror. Saving Private Ryan is one of their favorite films because they consider it an epic depiction of World War II.

They dislike musicals because they find them annoying and prefer movies whose themes are not conveyed through singing. They also disliked Ghostbusters (2016), agreeing with the interviewer's suggestion that it did not live up to the original; no further reasons were given.

They have seen Star Wars: The Last Jedi and thought it was fantastic, specifically enjoying the spaceships and all the Star Wars characters.
